name: Espresso Martini
description: Classic, sweet, smooth, and keeps you awake
instructions:
• 2oz (6cl) Vodka
• 0.5oz (1.5cl) Kahlua
• 0.5oz (1.5cl) Syrup
• 1oz (3cl) Coffee
• Shake on Ice, filter, decorate (cocoa/beans)

name: Whisky Sour / Blue Curasour
description: Smooth, sweet, sour, with a slight smoky note
instructions:
• 4.5cl Bourbon Whisky
• 3cl Citrus Juice (+ orange skin)
• 1.5cl Syrup (sugar or Blue Curacao)
• 1 Egg White
• Shake on Ice, filter, decorate (orange skin)

name: Pina Colada
description: Very creamy with strong beach vibes
instructions:
• 2 drops of Citrus Juice
• 4cl Coconut Milk
• 2cl Cream
• 6cl Rum
• 8cl Pineapple Juice
• Ice or frozen Pineapple
• 1 big spoon of Powdered Sugar
• Blend and put in glass full of ice

name: Swimming Pool
description: Theoretically just an extended blue Pina Colada
instructions:
• 6cl Pineapple Juice
• 2cl Vodka
• 2cl Rum
• 2cl Coconut Cream / Milk
• 2cl Cream
• 1cl Blue Curacao Syrup
• 2 Ice Cubes
• Crushed Ice

name: Mojito
description: A refreshing classic; holiday feeling meets Havanna
instructions:
• 5cl Rum
• 2 Teaspoons Sugar
• 0.5 Limes
• 2 Mint Leaves
• Grind and fill with crushed ice & sparkling water

name: Daiquiri
description: Refreshing, sour, and dangerously easy to drink
instructions:
• 2oz (6cl) White Rum
• 1oz (3cl) Lime Juice
• 0.5oz (1.5 cl) Syrup
• Shake on ice, strain, garnish with sugar rim

name: Appletini
description: Strong on the sour apple part; for JD fans
instructions:
• 4.5cl Vodka
• 2.5cl Citrus Juice
• 2cl Apple Schnapps
• 2cl Apple Juice
• 2.5cl Syrup
• Shake with Ice and strain

name: Aviation
description: Something extravagant or floral; unique flower drink
instructions:
• 5cl Gin (Roku preferred)
• 1.5 cl Crème de Violette
• 1 cl Maraschino
• 1.5 cl Citrus Juice
• Shake with Ice / stir in ice and strain
• Garnish with brandied cherry, black berry or sugar rim

name: Grasshopper
description: Think mint and chocolate; „After Eight“
instructions:
• 3cl Crème de Mente (Pfeffi)
• 3cl Crème de Cacao
• 4cl Cream
• Shake with Ice and strain in glass
• Garnish with peppermint leaves, chocolate rim, or whipped cream + chocolate

name: Side Car
description: A refined, citrusy classic
instructions:
• 4cl Cognac
• 2cl Gran Manier
• 2cl Citrus Juice
• Sugar Rim + Orange Cest

name: Boulevardier
description: The “original” Negroni, but with whisky
instructions:
• 4cl Bourbon
• 3cl Campari
• 3cl Sweet Vermouth
• Style: Orange Cest

name: Negroni
description: Bittersweet and herbal; iconic aperitif
instructions:
• 3cl Gin
• 3cl Campari
• 3cl Sweet Vermouth
• Style: Orange Cest/Peel

name: Pink Lady
description: Beautiful and balanced; fruity apple drink
instructions:
• 4.5cl London Dry Gin
• 1.5cl Calvados/Apple Brandy
• 2cl Citrus Juice
• 1cl Grenadine
• 1 Egg White
• Style: Maraschino

name: Watermelon Mojito
description: Mojito, but with a more tropical note
instructions:
• 6cl White Rum
• 3 Slices Watermelon (mashed)
• 6 Mint Leaves
• 1.5cl Sugar Syrup
• Soda Water

name: Singapore Sling
description: Exotic and refreshing with cherry and citrus
instructions:
• 2cl Gin
• 1cl Cherry Liqor
• 1cl Gran Manier
• 0.5cl Grenadine
• 0.5cl Lime Juice
• 5-6cl Pineapple Juice
• 1 Dash Angostura Bitters
• 2cl Soda Water

name: Gin Fizz
description: Nice citrus-loaded option
instructions:
• 5cl Gin
• 3cl Citrus Juice
• 2cl Syrup
• Shake with Ice and strain in ice filled glass
• Fill up with soda water

name: Orange Margarita
description: Tequila is normally too bitter, but you still want that orange BANG
instructions:
• 4cl Silver / Blanco Tequila
• 2cl Cointreau
• 6cl Orange Juice
• 0.5 – 1cl Syrup
• Garnish with orange skin or chocolate

name: Tequila Sunrise
description: You like sweet orange drinks, but you hate the taste of tequila
instructions:
• 4cl Blanco Tequila to chilled glass (ice)
• 8cl Orange Juice
• 0.5cl Grenadine (careful so it sinks)

name: Orange Martini
description: Relaxed morning cocktail
instructions:
• 4cl Vodka
• 2cl Cointreau
• 4cl Orange Juice
• 1cl Syrup

name: Brandy Alexander
description: Rich and creamy with a touch of elegance. Milk-Dessert in a glass
instructions:
• 4.5cl Cognac
• 3cl Creme de Cacao
• 3cl Cream
• Style: Nut Meg or Choco

name: Old Fashioned
description: Simple, strong, and timeless
instructions:
• 6cl Bourbon
• 1ts Sugar
• 3 dash Angostura bitters
• Style: Orange Cest

name: Jack Rose
description: Fruit-forward and vibrant
instructions:
• 6cl Calvados
• 3cl Citrus Juice
• 1.5cl Grenadine
• Style: Citrus Cest

name: Cosmopolitan
description: The ideal cocktail for a party
instructions:
• 4cl Vodka
• 2cl Gran Manier
• 2cl Cranberry Juice
• 2cl Lime Juice
• Style: Orange Cest

name: Vesper
description: A unique Gin-based drink with various smooth notes
instructions:
• 6cl Gin
• 2cl Vodka
• 1-2cl Lillet

name: Hemingway Daiquiri
description: More fruity and sour since Hemingway did not like sugar
instructions:
• 6cl White Rum
• 1.5cl Maraschino Liqueur
• 2 cl Lime Juice
• 1.5 cl Grapefruit Juice
• Style: Lime

name: Lavender Gin Sour
description: Floral and refreshing
instructions:
• 4.5cl Gin
• 1.5cl Citrus Juice
• 1.5cl Lavender Syrup
• 1 Egg White
• Garnish with lavender or sugar rim

name: Kapp-Heinz
description: A family special: Sweet, smooth and strong
instructions:
• 3cl Calvados
• 3cl Gran Manier
• Garnish with half apple wheel & orange skin

name: Clover Club
description: Fruity and elegant with a silky texture
instructions:
• 6cl Gin
• 1.5cl Citrus Juice
• 1.5cl Raspberry Syrup
• 1 Egg White
• Garnish with 3 Raspberries

name: French Martini
description: Sweet and sophisticated
instructions:
• 5cl Vodka
• 0.5-1cl Raspberry Syrup
• 4cl Pineapple Juice

name: Strawberry Jam Sour
description: Too late for breakfast but you want strawberry jam
instructions:
• 6cl Gin
• 2 Barspoons Strawberry Jam
• 3cl Citrus Juice
• 1 Egg White

name: Blue Lady
description: Silky-smooth with beautiful orange and citrus finish
instructions:
• 4.5cl Gin
• 2.5cl Blue Curacao
• 3cl Citrus Juice
• 1cl Sugar Syrup
• 1 Egg White
• 3 Dashed Orange Bitters

name: Aperol Sour
description: Decision between a sour and an Aperol Spritz
instructions:
• 3cl Gin
• 6cl Aperol
• 3cl Citrus Juice
• 1.5cl Sugar Syrup
• 1 Egg White

name: Coconut & Campari Sour
description: If you like Negronis and Pina Coladas
instructions:
• 2.5cl Gin
• 2.5cl Campari
• 2.5cl Citrus Juice
• 2.5cl Coconut cream
• 1.5cl Sugar Syrup
• 1 Egg White

name: Crystal Skies
description: Refreshing culinary trip to Latin America
instructions:
• 6cl Pisco
• 2cl Lime Juice
• 1.5cl Blue Curacao
• 1cl Honey

name: Pineapple Bourbon Sour
description: If a Whisky Sour is not enough summer feeling
instructions:
• 6cl Bourbon
• 2cl Pineapple Juice
• 1.5cl Citrus Juice
• 1cl Honey
• 1 Egg White

name: (Straw)berry Negroni Sour
description: If a classic Negroni is too bitter
instructions:
• 3cl Gin
• 3cl Sweet Vermouth
• 3cl Campari
• 2 Strawberries (muddled)
• 3cl Citrus Juice
• 1.5cl Syrup
• 1 Egg White

name: Manhattan
description: A sophisticated, smooth classic
instructions:
• 4cl Bourbon/Rye
• 2cl Sweet Vermouth
• 2 Dashes Angostura Bitters

name: White Russian
description: Decadent and creamy coffee dessert
instructions:
• 4cl Vodka
• 2cl Kahlua
• 2cl Cream

name: Dark’n’Stormy
description: Bold and spicy, Caribbean style
instructions:
• 4cl Rum (Dark)
• 1cl Lime Juice
• 6cl Ginger Beer
• Garnish: Ginger and Lime Wheel

name: Mai Tai
description: A tropical classic, rich and vibrant
instructions:
• 5cl Rum (dark)
• 1-2cl Amaretto
• 2cl Gran Manier
• 5cl Pineapple Juice
• 2cl Syrup
• 1cl Lime Juice

name: Amaretto Sour
description: Sweet and tangy delight with almond flavor
instructions:
• 3cl Amaretto
• 1.5cl Bourbon
• 2cl Citrus Juice
• 0.5cl Sugar Syrup
• 1 Egg White
